message.content:
POSE 1: OK. Balanced stance, neutral spine, arms ready.
POSE 2: ISSUE. Asymmetric arm position; right leg bent awkwardly.
POSE 3: OK. Streamlined entry, limbs extended.
POSE 4: ISSUE. Left leg/knee appears hyperextended or misaligned relative to the body line.
POSE 5: ISSUE. Spine is excessively arched (swayback); legs are splayed asymmetrically.
POSE 6: ISSUE. Legs are unnaturally straight and vertical; balance looks unstable for a landing.
